resources.string: This backup is from a newer app version – update the app first. Nothing was imported.
This backup is not encrypted – check that it comes from you. Settings will be applied; a portfolio lock that is on stays on.
Restored: %1$s, %2$s.
This device no longer has the key to the app’s encrypted data, so the app started empty. Nothing was deleted. To get your watchlist and portfolio back, import a backup file under “%1$s” in Settings.
Saved data could not be unlocked
Not enough free memory to protect or open the backup with a password. Close other apps and try again.
Restore backup
Got it
Saved data unlocked again
An earlier key on this device opened the set-aside data again, so it is back. Data saved in the meantime was kept unchanged next to it.
Restore was interrupted
The app was closed while restoring a backup. Your previous data has been put back; nothing from the backup was kept.
The app was closed while restoring a backup, and the previous data could not be put back completely. Please check your watchlist and portfolio, or restore the backup again under “%1$s” in Settings.
The backup file could not be verified after saving – it reads back differently. Please save the backup to a new file.
Portfolio not restored from system backup
The portfolio copy from the Android system backup could not be read, even on a second attempt, and has been deleted. If you have a backup file, restore it under “%1$s” in Settings.
The saved portfolio can\'t be unlocked right now and isn\'t shown – it will be back after restarting the app. Changes made now won\'t be saved.
The saved watchlist can\'t be unlocked right now and isn\'t shown – it will be back after restarting the app. Changes made now won\'t be saved.
Backup isn\'t possible right now: the saved data can\'t be unlocked at the moment. Restart the app and try again.
Encryption not active yet – the portfolio is not being saved, changes are lost when the app closes. The app will try again at the next start.
